# UNCOMPLICATED URINARY TRACT INFECTIONS

# Uncomplicated UTI is an infection confined to the bladder in afebrile women or men without urinary catheter. Symptoms include dysuria, lower abdominal pain, and urgency.

NOT signs or symptoms: abnormal urinalysis alone, pyuria, falls, change in urine odor or color, delirium (acute mental status change, confusion) without systemic signs of infection. These may occur in patients with a UTI but alone are inadequate for diagnosis and empiric treatment.

---

For patients without signs or symptoms of UTI:
[Asymptomatic bacteriuria](asymp-bacteriuria)

Therapy:
## Men, empirical treatment

Preferred:
Nitrofurantoin SA 100 mg PO q12h R,O, CrCl =/>30 mL/min, for 7 days
Non-VA order for above
< OR >
Trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h R,DI for 7 days
Non-VA order for above

Primary alternative:
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h R for 7 days
Non-VA order for above

Secondary alternative:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h R,DI for 5 days
Non-VA order for above

## Women, empirical treatment

Preferred:
Nitrofurantoin SA 100 mg PO q12h R,O, CrCl =/>30 mL/min, for 5 days
\*Avoid nitrofurantoin in the third trimester
Non-VA order for above
< OR >
Trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO q12h R,DI for 3 days
\*Avoid trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole in the first and third trimesters
Non-VA order for above

Primary alternatives:
Fosfomycin 3GM sachet PO M once
Non-VA order for above
<OR>
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h R for 5 days
Non-VA order for above

Secondary alternative:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h R,DI for 3 days
Non-VA order for above

## Women, suppression

\*Avoid trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole in the first and third trimesters
\*Avoid nitrofurantoin in the third trimester
Trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 1/2 SS tablet PO q24h R,DI
Non-VA order for above
< OR >
Trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole 1 SS tablet PO once post-coitus R,DI
Non-VA order for above
< OR >
Nitrofurantoin SA 100 mg PO qhs R,O, CrCl =/>30 mL/min
Non-VA order for above
< OR >
Nitrofurantoin SA 100 mg PO once post-coitus R,O, CrCl =/>30 mL/min
Non-VA order for above
